selection: Keep the 2026-11-18 heavy-board ranks fixed. Audit all completed mutual games in the five official score-table snapshots at revision, including seven games beyond the original 101.
denominators: Two recorded players per match. Counts are worker- or tree-turns; an opportunity can repeat across turns. Supporting games are unique IDs. Alternative attack and defense labels can coexist.

definitions.intercept: Empty collector adjacent to exactly one eligible loaded opposing collector on a non-base cell. Confirmed requires hunter entering its cell, victim staying then disappearing, hunter surviving.
definitions.cargo: Loaded collector would risk lethal/tie collision if staying and has a nonlethal currently free alternative, away from enemy bases. Chosen counts any nonlethal landing.
definitions.heavy_clear_home: Quiet comparison local to the carrier: cargo >=100, sole adjacent free friendly base, alternate safe landing, no enemy can reach the base; chosen means entering it, not necessarily a deposit.
definitions.tree: Enemy planter standing on a non-expiring owned tree; friendly contest is a friendly worker targeting that square. Captures checked using ownership transitions.
